device.description: 12-bit 500 kSPS bipolar-input SAR ADC with internal 2.5 V reference and synchronous serial interface
device.note: ads7835.pdf (SBAS102) p.2 specifications (VCC 4.75-5.25 V, VIH, binary two's complement), p.3 pin configuration and assignments, p.8 Table I timing, digital interface, p.9 Figure 3 basic conversion timing, p.10 Figure 4 power-down timing, Figure 5 LSB-first timing, p.12 data format

pages: p.2 (specs), p.3 (pins), p.8 (Table I timing), p.9 (Figure 3), p.10 (Figures 4-5), p.12 (data format)
notModeled: analog input (+/-VREF bipolar range) and internal reference (VREF is the reference output, overdrivable by an external reference)

CONV is a convert-start input, not a chip select: the model treats it as an active-low frame (CONV held low through the transfer, Figure 4). In the Figure 3 use CONV pulses low and returns high while D11..D0 are still clocked out; the model then floats DATA at CONV rise
conversion is clocked by CLK (D11 driven after the first CLK falling edge, D0 valid at the 13th rising edge, DATA Hi-Z after the 13th falling edge); not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once
LSB-first read-out (CONV pulled high before the 12th clock and low during the 13th) and short-cycling
power-down when CONV is still low at the 13th clock, exited on CONV rising (no bus effect)
CONV-to-CLK setup/hold and clock period limits
variants: ADS7834 is the unipolar (0 to VREF, straight binary, +IN/-IN) version: own spec file.
